location.section: Shōbōgenzō Gyōji, opening section (not available locally)

paraphrase: On the great way of the buddhas and ancestors there is always unsurpassed continuous practice (gyōji); it circles as a way-ring (dōkan) without break: arousing the mind, practice, awakening and nirvāṇa, without the slightest gap between them — this is the way-ring of continuous practice.
speaker: Dōgen
translation_basis: skeleton paraphrase from memory of the Japanese text; original not quoted
